name: TerraIncognita
description: A WILDS domain generalization dataset with images from four camera locations and ten animal classes (about 24,000 images). It evaluates distribution-shift robustness, including worst-group accuracy, and is distinct from the WILDS FMoW, Camelyon, and iWildCam datasets. Data is not vendored; consult WILDS open terms.
citation: Beery, S., Van Horn, G., & Perona, P. (2018). Recognition in Terra Incognita. European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV). https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-01270-0_12; Terra Incognita dataset (Beery et al., CVPR 2018).
